transitions only. Do not guess bindings, manufacture approvals or use manual
move/start/resume to bypass a stage. Source artifacts are English; communicate
with the user in their preferred language. Unknown effects require settlement
before retry. Stay at the owning stage on errors; do not label missing proof PASS.
The selected Workflow owns plan acceptance: the independent Plan Review PASS
for the exact immutable R2 revision is its review decision. Storage publication
alone is not acceptance. Agents never call accept-plan or prepare-report-only.

Preserve exact native task baseline separately from a moving merge target.
Carry every declared parameter on normal transitions. A value not produced yet
is explicitly 'not-yet-produced' with its reason, never a fabricated reference
or PASS. Start/early cancellation may have no plan/candidate/review. Later
stages must verify their required real evidence; absence never satisfies a gate.

only the actual Cleanup owner may submit its observed result.
Verify carried review references against actual native producer/transition
records and immutable bytes; self-reported PASS text is not proof. A reviewer
must be independent of the writer, and stale plan/candidate identities block.

Own Plan. Resolve ordinary R2 using the installed qualified
kent-project-memory workflow interface and genuine current identity. At first
actual Plan ingress initialize-task; resolve an existing binding before retry.
Use the adapter's closed request schema and CAS-publish the plan as an immutable
revision, then read back exact bytes/digest. Preserve original user decisions
and scope/effect boundaries, requirements, tests and completion outcome.
Carry one serialized plan_ref with document key, exact revision and SHA-256,

the prior immutable ref and feedback, publish a fresh revision and review it.
Choose plan_for_review only after publication/readback. If missing information
requires a user decision ask and remain here; authorized cancellation uses
plan_cancel with real authority and preserved references.

edges.prompt:
Read .kent/context/engineering-lite.md FIRST, then its required sources.
Use genuine current native Task/Node/Session identity and supported normal
transitions only. Do not guess bindings, manufacture approvals or use manual
move/start/resume to bypass a stage. Source artifacts are English; communicate
with the user in their preferred language. Unknown effects require settlement
before retry. Stay at the owning stage on errors; do not label missing proof PASS.
The selected Workflow owns plan acceptance: the independent Plan Review PASS
for the exact immutable R2 revision is its review decision. Storage publication
alone is not acceptance. Agents never call accept-plan or prepare-report-only.
There is no Script acceptance, legacy ledger/checkpoint or Janitor in this route.
Preserve exact native task baseline separately from a moving merge target.
Carry every declared parameter on normal transitions. A value not produced yet
is explicitly 'not-yet-produced' with its reason, never a fabricated reference
or PASS. Start/early cancellation may have no plan/candidate/review. Later
stages must verify their required real evidence; absence never satisfies a gate.
Native callbacks carry the result, not Task comments. At terminal transitions,
only the actual Cleanup owner may submit its observed result.
Verify carried review references against actual native producer/transition
records and immutable bytes; self-reported PASS text is not proof. A reviewer
must be independent of the writer, and stale plan/candidate identities block.

Own fully Agent Cleanup per the mapped cleanup-lite procedure.
Verify disposition and original deletion/branch authority; preserve complete
work evidence outside the exact retiring root before effects. Release only
proven owners, use supported leave/delete, independently prove original path
and Git registration absence and report native/branch disposition. Unknown,
scheduled, interrupted or unqualified effects stay here; never replay blindly.
cleanup_delivered requires actual delivered disposition AND proven cleanup;
cleanup_not_delivered requires authorized non-delivery AND proven cleanup.
No resource loss, fake identity, Script Janitor, seal or acceptance bypass.
